overview.title: Service Overview
overview.description: We handle web development end-to-end — planning, design, and build — from a single landing page to a full corporate site or custom web app. Every project ships with clean code, responsive design, and SEO fundamentals built in, so your site looks great and performs from day one.

benefits.title: Why teams choose us
benefits.description: Every project is built the same way we build LeadFlow AI itself — with care, speed, and an obsession with the details.

items.title: Premium, Modern Design
items.description: Every layout is custom-designed — no generic templates — so your site looks and feels like nothing else in your industry.

items.title: Built for Speed
items.description: Next.js and modern tooling under the hood mean fast load times, smooth animations, and happier visitors.

items.title: SEO-Ready from Day One
items.description: Clean semantic markup, metadata, and structured content so search engines can find and rank your site.

items.title: Mobile-First & Responsive
items.description: Every page is designed to look flawless on phones, tablets, and desktops alike.

items.title: Transparent, Milestone-Based Delivery
items.description: You see progress at every stage and pay as milestones are completed — no surprises.

items.title: Ongoing Support & Maintenance
items.description: Launch day isn't the finish line — we stay on to fix, update, and grow your site as your business does.
